examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
I grew up in a communal flat.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
He just ran out of here.

examples.text: У тебя нет знакомого, который на гитаре играет?
examples.trans: Don't you know anyone who plays the guitar?

examples.trans: Have you seen a guy with a guitar around here?

meanings.en: наступать на те же грабли = to make the same mistake again

examples.text: Зачем ты наступаешь на те же грабли?
examples.trans: Why do you keep making the same mistake?
Take the rake and clear up the leaves.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

лезть.gloss: to climb; to push in, to barge in

meanings.note: Лезть на дерево = to climb a tree.

meanings.en: to push in, to barge in
meanings.note: лезть без очереди = to jump the queue; лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone
colloquial: не лезь! = keep out of it!

examples.trans: The cat is climbing the tree.

examples.trans: You're a bribe-taker! You're pushing in ahead of a sick child.

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: навести порядок = to put in order

examples.trans: I will establish iron order here.

examples.trans: Wait! But it has become more painful for him to step.

meanings.en: once, on one occasion, one day

examples.trans: One day everything around can change drastically.

examples.text: Всегда мечтала познакомиться с друзьями моего парня.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

examples.text: Приезжай сейчас! Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Come over right now! Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

побыть.gloss: to stay for a while, to be (briefly)

meanings.en: to be, to spend a little time
meanings.note: побыть одной / одному = to be alone for a while

examples.trans: Let's stay here a little longer.

examples.text: Забирайте и уходите. Я хочу побыть одна.
examples.trans: Take it and go. I want to be alone.
